findings.problem: The sanitizer is dynamically executed after checking only identities in its own mutable receipt; the identity-bound GO does not pin that receipt. Replacing sanitizer, derived output and receipt together would pass GO and execute unreviewed code.
findings.required_change: Require GO.sanitization_receipt_sha256 to match the receipt hash before any dynamic execution. The receipt then binds reviewed sanitizer and derived output hashes.

resolved_v2_findings: Freeze-produced fifth empty before snapshot is now required and checked as exactly empty.
Strict argv exactly matches reviewed Core/Store/App all-targets producer.
Unproduced measurement cwd requirement removed; exact producer command paths and pinned driver remain.
Pinned raw host file preserved; separately derived sanitized metadata excludes command stderr and replaces numeric battery ID. Receipt hashes and actual output fields independently matched by reads.
limitations: Static review only; no packager/parser/sanitizer/driver function executed.
No actual runtime packaging failure claimed; prior reports preserved.
